title: R1.01 repaired: input injection + ReZero thinking + ponder warm-up, and a training budget where baselines stop improving
question: Does the persistent-state + adaptive-recurrence prototype beat parameter- and FLOP-matched Transformers once (a) thinking can no longer erase the state and (b) the models are trained long enough to learn the tasks?

changes_from_r1_01.budget: 15,000 steps instead of 3,000 (every model), so the comparison is not decided by under-training
changes_from_r1_01.rouge-b: inject=True (query embedding re-fed at every think step), rezero=True (learned residual gate starting at 0), tau warm-up (no ponder cost for the first 30% of steps)
changes_from_r1_01.kept: benchmark, frozen eval sets, optimizer, lr schedule, batch, seeds, both Transformer baselines; the original R1.01 prototype ('rouge') is re-run at the new budget to separate the effect of budget from the effect of the repairs

setup.data: benchmarks/microbench.py, ID ranges for training, fresh stream per seed
setup.hardware: CPU, GitHub Actions runners (4 threads per run)

predictions.P1_state: State, OOD: rouge-b >= transformer + 0.20 (mean of 3 seeds) and ahead in every seed.
predictions.P2_hops: Hops, OOD: rouge-b >= transformer + 0.10, and rouge-b's think steps rise with the hop count (Spearman rho >= 0.6 over levels 1-8).
predictions.P3_recall: Recall: transformer >= rouge-b, ID and OOD (fixed-size state; predicted loss).
predictions.P4_repairs: rouge-b OOD all >= rouge OOD all - 0.02, and 16 think steps at test do not reduce rouge-b's OOD accuracy.
predictions.P5_compute: Where P1/P2 hold, rouge-b also beats the FLOP-matched transformer on that task.

decision.advance: (P1 and P5 on state) or (P2 and P5 on hops): proceed to R1.02 and R1.03 with rouge-b.
decision.fail: Otherwise: record the result; the next step is the cheaper-read / hybrid design (R1.09, R1.11), not scaling.

not_claimed: Input injection and gated residual recurrence are prior art (recurrent-depth models, ReZero). R1.01b tests whether they make this prototype useful; no novelty claim.
